name: edge_bevel_post_selection
description: Ledger row 2: after an edge bevel the reference leaves the new band's EDGES selected; we leave POLYGONS, while still reporting edge mode. Measured here on a 3-segment unit cube, where the two engines' bevel GEOMETRY agrees exactly — so the divergence is isolated to the selection.
source: Reference half: the frozen wave-1 probe capture of the post-bevel state (task 1120). vibe3d half: measured live against this tree. Ledger row: 2.

provenance.harness: tools/local/fixture_gen/cmd_divergence (task 1130), over the task-1120 headless probe capture
provenance.notes: Headless COMMAND capture — no display, no pointer injection, no gesture. The ledger row was found on the pilot's patch, whose intermediate mesh was never dumped and whose amounts are substituted; this cell re-measures the same law on a base both engines build from one command, and the geometry half converges exactly, which the pilot's counts could not show. The reference's selection MODE did not read back in that capture and is therefore absent, not assumed.

cases.name: band_edges_there_polygons_here
